item.title: Flower Of Life Belt
item.description: Black and brown Flower of Life leather belts, close-up of the engraved pattern. A high quality leather belt featuring an intricate Flower of Life pattern, flowing continuously around the entire belt. Overlapping circles evolve into complex geometric forms, creating a mesmerising pattern that feels both organic and precise. Designed by 1000 Errors.
